task.name: JointIE typed relation decoding
task.notes: beam search, no_self_loops, unique_head on leads/subsidiary_of, symmetric partnered_with. Infeasible graphs drop relations rather than store an inconsistent graph. source_type/target_type persisted. D13

task.name: LLM escalation path for ambiguous documents
task.notes: LlmExtractor (OpenAI-compatible chat completions; Pratt router pratt-medium when PRATT_LLM_API_KEY is set, else OpenRouter gpt-4o-mini) + EscalatingExtractor wrapper (opt-in via EXTRACTION_ESCALATE/--escalate). Triggers: no mentions, no relations, majority low-confidence, or sparse relation density. Verified live: pure 'llm' backend end-to-end (gpt-4o-mini) and spaCy+escalate; Pratt pratt-medium verified live. See DECISIONS.md D11/D12

task.name: Entity alignment via Jev Score routing (separate / curator / merge)
task.notes: resolve.ensure_entity routes fuzzy (trigram) candidates through align_pair; merge links + alias, curator creates + queues, separate creates. Verified live: 'Maria Chen' vs 'Dr. Maria Chen' score 1.84 -> merge. See DECISIONS.md D9

task.name: Relation validation via Jev Noul (does the evidence sentence assert this?)
task.notes: graph_store.build_from_proposals judges pending proposals. Jev asks assertion Noul plus a modality Choice; non-fact argmax or noul below the frozen 0.5 cutoff (D15) sets status=rejected. Sample before the modality question: 14 candidates, 9 promoted, 5 falsehoods rejected. See DECISIONS.md D9/D14

task.name: Local Decide gate when no Jev key is set
task.notes: extract/decide.py: separate modality and relation-agreement passes via gliner2.classification.Classifier. Argmax only; the 0.5 cutoff is not applied to Decide probabilities. Unscored claims still promote. D14

decision.title: Relational edge tables + CTEs now, Apache AGE later if needed
GLiNER2 primary extractor; spaCy fallback; LLM only for escalation
Use Jev (SystemOne) for calibrated typed decisions in the extraction pipeline
Reified facts with provenance; relationships are an aggregate view
NetworkX loads only from graph views; pyvis for interactive output
Long documents: overlapping sentence windows with rebased offsets
Jev is not the extractor; keep a local span model for candidates
GLiNER2 backend uses AutoExtractor + gliner2.5-base-v1; CUDA torch from the PyTorch index
Jev integration: alignment routing, batched Noul validation, OpenRouter inference
Sentence boundaries at paragraph breaks, not single newlines
LLM escalation is an opt-in wrapper over the cheap extractor
Pratt router is the default LLM and Jev provider
Relation candidates come from JointIE, not independent relations()
Modality gate: Jev Choice beside the Noul; Decide when there is no key
Gold facts before any cutoff change; 0.5 stays frozen
